mentions.name: easycad
mentions.description: A 2D CAD application written in Rust using WGPU. It is in early stages as a side project but already supports drawing lines and circles, copying or moving shapes, deleting, snapping, creating text, and a few other basic drawing operations.
mentions.source_excerpt:
2D CAD app in Rust with WGPU.

Why? Because why not? I love CAD.

It's still very much in the early stages because it's just a side project for me, but, it is possible to draw lines and circles, copy or move them, delete, snap, create text, and a couple of other basic stuff.
